could_not_build.detail: clearance is MAO-A mediated (CLint 5546 uL/min/mg on MAO-A; ~80% unchanged after 4 h in human hepatocytes, FDA NDA 218145), which the liver-microsome assay misses, and no rat i.v. plasma CL is reported; binding is IC50, not Ki.
could_not_build.name: centanafadine

could_not_build.detail: OX2R Ki 0.13 nM is published, but no numeric rat i.v. plasma CL or human microsome CLint is in the open literature (Bonaventure et al. 2015, JPET, is paywalled).
could_not_build.name: seltorexant

could_not_build.detail: M4 potency is a functional EC50 (12.3 nM, Butler et al. 2024 J Med Chem), not a binding Ki, and no rat i.v. CL / human microsome CLint is openly available.
could_not_build.name: emraclidine

could_not_build.detail: KOR Ki 1.5 nM is published (Guerrero et al. 2019, PMID 30707578) but the only rat i.v. CL is 105 mL/min/kg (fed rats), above the plasma-CL plausibility cap, and the hepatocyte/microsome CLint is reported pre-scaled to mL/min/kg, not the per-protein unit the extractor reads.
could_not_build.name: navacaprant

could_not_build.detail: S1R Ki 57 nM and clean human CL (541 mL/min, extensive metabolisers) are published, but no rat i.v. plasma CL or human microsome CLint is openly available.
could_not_build.name: pridopidine

could_not_build.detail: KOR Ki 0.32 nM is published (FDA NDA 214916), but difelikefalin is a renally-cleared peptide with no hepatic CLint and no clean rat i.v. plasma CL; its only human CL is a hemodialysis-population popPK estimate.
could_not_build.name: difelikefalin

could_not_build.detail: rat i.v. CL 11.2 mL/min/kg is published (PMID 35882204) but zelquistinel is a spermine-site NMDA allosteric modulator with no measurable binding Ki at any site, so the binding panel has no measured affinity and the product refuses.
could_not_build.name: zelquistinel

could_not_build.detail: deutetrabenazine is a prodrug; the human PK (CL/F 47 and 70 L/h, FDA NDA 208082) is for the active metabolites alpha/beta-HTBZ, not the dosed molecule the binding panel describes, and the product has no metabolite model.
could_not_build.name: deutetrabenazine

sourcing.aticaprant: aticaprant (JNJ-67953964 / LY2456302 / CERC-501), kappa-opioid antagonist. Human KOR/MOR/DOR Ki and rat i.v. CL 89.3 mL/min/kg (1 mg/kg, cannulated SD rats) from Rorick-Kehn et al. 2014, Neuropharmacology 77:131-144, PMID 24071566.
sourcing.samidorphan: samidorphan (ALKS 33), opioid antagonist. Human opioid-receptor Ki, human liver-microsome CLint 11.15 uL/min/mg (Study AM-0313-02) and human plasma protein binding 23-33% (fu taken as 0.72) from the FDA Lybalvi Multidiscipline Review, NDA 213378 (2021).
sourcing.ulotaront: ulotaront (SEP-363856), TAAR1/5-HT1A agonist. Radioligand 5-HT1A binding Ki 284 nM from Koblan et al. 2021, ACS Med Chem Lett (DOI 10.1021/acsmedchemlett.1c00527); TAAR1 agonism is functional (EC50 ~38 nM, Dedic et al. 2019, JPET 371:1-14, PMID 31371483) and is not a binding Ki, so it is not used as the package affinity. Rat i.v. CL 42.7 mL/min/kg and rat F ~100% from Xiao et al. 2022, Pharm Res 39:837-850, PMID 35484370.
